name: Faithless Templar

Traits.name: Aura of Authority
Traits.text: While in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the templar, the templar and its allies have Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws, provided the templar doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The templar makes three Mace attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Shield Bash.

Actions.name: Mace
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. 17 (3d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of the templar's next turn.
Actions.clause: a templar priest with a mace

Actions.name: Shield Slam
Actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 15, one creature within 5 feet. *Failure:* The target is pushed up to 15 feet away from the templar and has the Prone condition.
Actions.expressedQuote: The target is pushed up to 15 feet away from the templar and has the Prone condition.

Actions.name: Shield Bash
Actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw*: DC 15, one creature within 5 feet that the templar can see. *Failure:*  9 (2d4 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

lore: The Order raises its templars without prayer or miracle — only drills, walled courtyards, and the mace, which is why faithless bishops fear the ones they send.

generation.userConcept: a templar priest with a mace and no magic at all
